# SupportIQ Copilot Instructions

## Project identity

This project is SupportIQ.

Project purpose:
- Retrieval-augmented question answering for customer support automation
- Parameter-efficient fine-tuning using LoRA and QLoRA
- Enterprise-grade support assistant experience

## Hard requirements

- The SupportIQ logo is locked.
- Do not redesign, regenerate, replace, recolor, or reinterpret the logo.
- The supplied UI images/screenshots are the visual source of truth.
- The selected first/simple UI-state design is also locked.
- Follow the provided design references exactly unless the user explicitly approves a change.
- Keep the application professional, natural, enterprise-grade, human-designed, polished, and realistic.
- Do not add robots, AI mascots, planets, space themes, stars, futuristic decorations, generic AI brain graphics, excessive neon, excessive glow, or unnecessary 3D elements.
- Do not start application feature implementation until the user explicitly approves the next division.

## Working rules for agents

- Preserve existing work and do not delete user files.
- Do not fabricate repository history, assets, or screenshots.
- Do not invent missing project files or technologies if they are not present.
- Keep the workspace clean and structured.
- If the user asks for a new division, complete only that division and stop before the next one unless instructed otherwise.
- Prefer a minimal, deliberate implementation strategy over unnecessary scope expansion.
- Ask for user approval before moving from one division to another.

## Scope boundary

This repository is currently in the preparation/setup stage.
Do not implement business features yet.
Focus only on project setup, instructions, and scaffolding while the design references remain authoritative.
